entries.summary: Check, list, get and search the contract data files (connections, role assignments, data policy, capabilities, features, versions, settings, extensions)
entries.inputs: a data id, an entry id or search words
entries.outputs: JSON or text; exit 1 with a catalog code when a file is invalid or an id is unknown

entries.summary: Lint the test map and select the selftests a change can affect
Render, explain and validate alert codes; regenerate docs/alert-codes.md
What a role needs from any model that serves it: tool calling, context size, vision and the data classes it may see
entries.outputs: JSON; exit 1 with STL-CFG-311 when the role is unknown

entries.summary: Count literal provider, model, host, board, project and channel names in code against the baseline
entries.outputs: exit 0 clean, 1 over the baseline, 2 with STL-CFG-310 when an input cannot be read

entries.summary: Append one line to the event log with secrets masked, or read its last lines
entries.inputs: an event (who, what, old, new) or a line count
entries.outputs: one JSON line per event; STL-CFG-318 when the log cannot be written

entries.summary: Report drift of an applied data file and list its apply history
entries.outputs: drift lines or history; STL-CFG-314 on drift

entries.summary: Apply or roll back a data file through the apply contract: dry run, backup, idempotent apply, one event line
entries.inputs: a data file id and a candidate file
entries.outputs: the change summary; STL-CFG-312 for a worker on an owner-only file, STL-CFG-313 when the candidate is invalid

entries.summary: The owner's command to read or change one setting from the settings registry: validates the value, then writes through the apply contract
entries.inputs: a setting key and, to change it, a value
entries.outputs: the value or the change summary; STL-CFG-311 for an unknown key, STL-CFG-312 for a worker, STL-CFG-315 for a bad value, STL-CFG-317 when an identity-critical setting is changed without a terminal
